units.source_text: 后来他又说：“你至今不曾替我生个皇子，真是遗憾。

en.t: Later he said again, "It is truly regrettable that you have never borne me an imperial prince.

units.source_text: 我想遵循父皇遗命，让皇太子即帝位。

en.t: I wish to follow my father's dying command and have the Crown Prince ascend the throne.

units.source_text: 可是其间阻碍甚多，教人好生烦恼！”

en.t: But there are so many obstacles in the way that it fills me with distress!"

units.source_text: 盖当时权臣满朝，朱雀帝不能随意执行政令。

en.t: At that time, powerful ministers filled the court, and Emperor Suzaku could not freely carry out government orders.

units.source_text: 他年纪还轻，性情又甚柔弱。

en.t: He was still young, and his nature was also very gentle and weak.
As a result, he had many painful troubles.
